English Language Proficiency Requirement
English Language Proficiency Requirement
All admitted undergraduate, postbaccalaureate, and graduate students interested in attending PSU on non-immigrant visas must submit documentation to demonstrate proof of English language proficiency. See below for the specific requirements for each level.
Undergraduate and Postbaccalaureate
All admitted undergraduate and postbaccalaureate students on non-immigrant visas must submit one of the test results below to demonstrate proof of English language proficiency.
Minimum Test Score Requirements
TOEFL, IELTS, PTE, or SAT with minimum required official score achieved within the last two years. SAT is not required for admission; for use to prove English proficiency only. IELTS One Skill Retake scores cannot be accepted. When ordering test score reports, use Portland State's institutional code: 4610.
Test
Minimum Score
TOEFL
IBT taken before 1/21/2026 : Minimum Overall 71; Minimum subscore 15 in reading and writing
IBT taken on or after 1/21/2026: Minimum Overall 4.0; Minimum subscore 3.5 in reading and writing
Academic IELTS
6.0 overall; minimum 6.0 in reading and writing (We do not accept IELTS One Skill Retake scores)
Academic PTE
53 overall
SAT
560 or above in the Evidence-Based Reading and Writing section
DET (Duolingo English Test)
110 or above
Other Ways to Demonstrate Proficiency
Transferable associate degree from a U.S. institution with a minimum GPA of 2.50 and 8 credits of college level writing—including the equivalent of WR 121 and an additional higher level college writing course. Both courses must be completed with a grade of C- or better (Successful completion of English, Writing, or Literature classes alone is not sufficient to demonstrate English language proficiency).
Transcript with the bachelor's degree posted from the institution granting a 4-year bachelor’s degree, master’s or doctoral degree at a college or university in Australia, English-speaking Canada, Ghana, Ireland, Kenya, New Zealand, Nigeria, South Africa, Uganda, United Kingdom, United States, or Zimbabwe.
Passport copy demonstrating that you are a citizen of Australia, English-speaking Canada, Ghana, Ireland, Kenya, New Zealand, Nigeria, South Africa, Uganda, United Kingdom, or Zimbabwe and proof of entire academic history in English from one of those countries.
International Baccalaureate diploma with final combined score of 30 or more points.
Certificate of Completion of the Level 5 English language program through PSU's ESL partner: Pacific International Academy at University of Portland.
Portland Community College ESOL Program Level 8: Completion of PCC ESOL program with grades of B or better in the following Courses: ESOL Level 7 254 Communication, ESOL Level 8 262 Writing, ESOL Level 8 260 Reading.
Students who do not qualify under the university's minimum English language proficiency requirements listed on this page may also submit documentation that they feel demonstrates their mastery of English language proficiency; they may do so in the form of both citizenship documentation or educational documentation that they feel best represents their English language ability. This documentation may be considered in waiving university English language proficiency requirements but requires the applicant to submit a formal written request for an "ESL review" by email (intladm@pdx.edu) to the undergraduate international admissions office.
Graduate
All graduate applicants must demonstrate English language proficiency in one of the ways outlined below prior to enrolling in academic classes. This requirement applies to all students, including permanent residents and U.S. citizens.
Valid Proof of English Language Proficiency
Completion of a bachelor's, master's or doctoral degree in Australia, English-speaking Canada, Ghana, Ireland, Kenya, New Zealand, Nigeria, South Africa, Uganda, United Kingdom, United States, or Zimbabwe, or:
Minimum required official score on the International Test of English as a Foreign Language (TOEFL), the International English Language Testing System-Academic (IELTS) exam, or the Pearson Test of English-Academic (PTE); less than two years old at time of matriculation. Test scores more than two years old are accepted if the score exceeded the minimum requirement and you have maintained continuous residency in the United States since the exam date. Due to the Covid-19 pandemic and testing center closures globally, PSU’s Graduate School will accept home based test scores from the following English language exams: TOEFL iBT Special Home Edition, IELTS Indicator or Duolingo English Test (DET) during this time.
Minimum Test Score Requirements for Graduate Programs
TOEFL
Academic IELTS
Academic PTE
Duolingo Test of English (DET)
TOEFL:
For exams taken before January 21, 2026:
Minimum overall score of 80 with minimum subscores of 18 in reading and writing.
For exams taken on or after January 21, 2026:
Minimum overall of 4.5 with minimum subscores of 4 in reading and writing.
IELTS: 6.5 overall score with minimum sub-scores of 6.5 in reading and writing
PTE: 60 overall
DET: 120 overall
